sector: Super St-Bernard / Bourg-Saint-Bernard / Col Nord de Menouve
coverage_scope: Swiss-side sector and surrounding border tiles; metadata tile extents do not guarantee complete Italian-side point coverage.
recommended_terrain_source: Latest swissALTI3D 0.5 m GeoTIFF; bare terrain with vegetation and buildings removed.
recommended_point_cloud_use: Use classified swissSURFACE3D for ground (LAS class 2), vegetation, buildings and rock detail.
quality_verification_scope: STAC inventory; HTTP 200 for two LAS ZIPs; GDAL read of raster headers and one non-nodata pixel in each of two 2024 MNT tiles. Full LiDAR classification and local terrain quality have not been analysed.
